title: phalangium pugioniforme
intro: Phalangium pugioniforme, commonly known as the "Iron Cross", is a plant species in the genus Phalangium. It is a type of succulent plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, known for its iron-cross like appearance. The health benefits of Phalangium pugioniforme include its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
